title: Witness of the Holy Spirit
definition: The witness of the Holy Spirit is His testimony to Christ, the Gospel, and the believer's adoption in God's family.
summary: The Spirit bears witness to Christ and assures believers that they belong to God.
christFocus: Jesus promised that the Spirit would testify about Him and empower His people to bear witness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit witnesses to Christ. He testifies to Jesus' identity, saving work, resurrection, and lordship. He also empowers believers to bear witness to the Gospel.

The Spirit witnesses internally to believers that they are children of God, strengthening assurance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People may seek spiritual experiences that do not bear witness to Christ. This doctrine matters because the Spirit's testimony is Christ-centered.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask whether your witness and spiritual life point clearly to Jesus. Rely on the Spirit to testify through truth, love, and boldness.
